# MyCareerCompany — Target JD Database v3 (Company × Domain × Level × Role): Antigravity Context File

**Single source of truth for the v3 Target JD picker in the MyCareerCompany Resume Checker** (www.mycareercompany.com/resumechecker). Users choose a **company** (or **Other** and a company type), a **target domain** and a **career level**; the database generates a JD written for that combination, features the best-fitting **role** and offers the other roles. Compiled 22 October 2026. Confidential.

## 0. How to use this file

1. In the Antigravity workspace **mcc-resumechecker**, save this file as `docs/MyCareerCompany_JD_Database_v3_Antigravity_Context.md`. Keep the filename: the extraction script defaults to this path.
2. Paste the prompt in 0.1 into the Antigravity agent.
3. Review the plan Artifact, then approve it.
4. Check the result against the acceptance checklist in Section 10.

The agent does **not** need to read Section 11. Task 1 extracts the six data layers with a script and verifies their counts and checksums, so nothing is retyped or truncated.

### 0.1 Prompt to paste into the Antigravity agent

```text
Read docs/MyCareerCompany_JD_Database_v3_Antigravity_Context.md (Sections 0–10; do not read Section 11 – it is data).
Implement the v3 Target JD Database exactly as specified:
1. Task 1: create scripts/extract-jd-database-v3.mjs and the "jd:extract:v3" npm script; run it to write src/data/jd-v3/*.json.
2. Tasks 2–6: create or replace the files listed in Section 2 with the code given. Do not change the generator logic,
   the data, or the scoring engine (src/lib/scoring.ts).
3. Task 7: add tests/jdV3.test.ts. Keep tests/jdLibrary.test.ts (v2) unchanged.
4. Run: npm run jd:extract:v3, npm run test, npm run build. Fix failures without weakening or deleting tests.
5. Produce a plan Artifact first; after implementation, show the acceptance checklist (Section 10) with evidence.
```

## 1. Agent rules (add to AGENTS.md)

```markdown
## Target JD Database v3 rules
- Data source of truth: src/data/jd-v3/*.json, generated ONLY by `npm run jd:extract:v3` from the context file. Never hand-edit
  these files in the app repo; edit the context file (or the build pipeline) and re-extract.
- JDs are generated at request time by src/lib/jdgen.ts. It is deterministic: the same company, domain, level and role
  always produce the same JD. Never add randomness, timestamps or LLM calls to it.
- Sample JDs never go through LLM JD extraction; JDFacts come from toJDFactsV3().
- Every JD shown to users carries its disclaimer, class banner (if any), eligibility label and flags. Never hide them.
- Eligibility and certifications are advice only; never knockouts. Must-have skills are the only knockouts.
- Never show compensation, and never imply guaranteed interviews or placement.
- Company names may appear only inside generated JDs with the "Illustrative sample … not an official JD" disclaimer.
```

| Field | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `jdSource` | `sample` | Unchanged |
| `jdCompany` | `hindustan-unilever` or `other` | Company ID from the picker data |
| `jdArchetype` | `AR11` | Required when `jdCompany = other` |
| `jdSegment` | `SME banking` | Optional, for `other` only |
| `jdDomain` | `MKT` | One of 28 domain codes |
| `jdLevel` | `CAMPUS` | CAMPUS, EARLY, MID or SENIOR |
| `jdRole` | `MKT:brand-management` | Optional; defaults to the featured role |

### API

- `GET /resumechecker/api/jds/v3` → `{ libraryVersion, generatorVersion, companies[{id,name,sector,archetype}], otherTypes[{code,name,segments}], domains[{code,name}], levels[...] }` (public, cached).
- `GET /resumechecker/api/jds/v3/card?company=itc&domain=AGB&level=CAMPUS[&role=AGB:commodity-procurement]`
- `GET /resumechecker/api/jds/v3/card?company=other&type=AR11&segment=SME%20banking&domain=SAL&level=MID`
  → `{ jd, notes }` (scoring internals omitted); `400` with a readable message for invalid input.

---

## 3. How a JD is generated

`JD = BASE[domain, level] + ROLE[role, level] + OVERLAY[company → company type] + CLASS[company, domain] + LEVEL GATE`

1. **Base JD** (112): level scope, Mid/Senior duties, skills, education, cut-off code, certification rules, keywords, must-haves, scoring inputs.
2. **Role** (236): the featured role is the one whose affinity list ranks the company's type highest, penalised if the role usually starts above the chosen level or is a trainee role at Mid/Senior. Ties rotate across uncurated peers so sector peers feature different roles.
3. **Company overlay**: title ladder (company → company type → role title), summary (company, sector, business line relevant to the domain, main customers, programme at Campus), three company responsibility lines from domain templates (business lines, customers, regulators, domain KPIs; rotated deterministically), eligibility precedence (company rule → company-type norm → base level norm), regulator-specific conditional certifications, keywords and campus presence.
4. **Class** per company × domain: CORE (main business or library-recorded hiring), INTERNAL (in-house function), ADJACENT (closest equivalent, e.g., IB → Corporate Development & M&A), ATYPICAL (extrapolated, flagged). Order: curated override → library hired domains → library industry domain → company-type default → rule for unlisted domains.
5. **Level gate**: experience band and scope line per level; experience-gated credentials never required at Campus; degree knockout only for CORE Campus JDs.

Every card also carries `flags`, a 64-bit `fingerprint`, `disclaimer` and `generatorVersion`.

## 4. Tasks (all code)

### Task 1 — Extraction script

Create `scripts/extract-jd-database-v3.mjs`:

```js
// Extracts the six v3 data layers from the Antigravity context file, verifies counts and checksums,
// and writes src/data/jd-v3/*.json. Usage: node scripts/extract-jd-database-v3.mjs [path/to/context.md]
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import crypto from "node:crypto";

const src = process.argv[2] ?? "docs/MyCareerCompany_JD_Database_v3_Antigravity_Context.md";
const outDir = "src/data/jd-v3";
const md = fs.readFileSync(src, "utf8");
const LAYERS = ["companies", "archetypes", "roles", "base", "hooks", "meta"];

fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
for (const name of LAYERS) {
  const tag = `JDV3_${name.toUpperCase()}`;
  const block = md.match(new RegExp(`<!-- ${tag}_START -->\\s*\`\`\`json\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)\`\`\`\\s*<!-- ${tag}_END -->`));
  if (!block) throw new Error(`${name}: JSON block not found between the ${tag}_START/END markers.`);
  const data = JSON.parse(block[1]);
  const expectedSha = md.match(new RegExp(`${tag}_SHA256:\\s*([a-f0-9]{64})`))?.[1];
  const expectedCount = Number(md.match(new RegExp(`${tag}_COUNT:\\s*(\\d+)`))?.[1]);
  const count = Array.isArray(data) ? data.length : Object.keys(data).length;
  if (count !== expectedCount) throw new Error(`${name}: expected ${expectedCount} entries, found ${count}.`);
  const sha = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest("hex");
  if (sha !== expectedSha) throw new Error(`${name}: checksum mismatch (${sha} vs ${expectedSha}). The block was edited or truncated.`);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(data) + "\n");
  console.log(`Wrote ${outDir}/${name}.json: ${count} entries, sha256 ${sha.slice(0, 12)}…`);
}
```

Add to `package.json` → `"scripts"`: `"jd:extract:v3": "node scripts/extract-jd-database-v3.mjs"`. Run it and commit `src/data/jd-v3/*.json`. `tsconfig.json` must have `"resolveJsonModule": true` (Next.js default).

### Task 2 — Generator: `src/lib/jdgen.ts`

```ts
// MyCareerCompany — Target JD generator v3 (Company × Domain × Level × Role).
// JD = BASE[domain, level] ⊕ ROLE[role, level] ⊕ OVERLAY[company → archetype] ⊕ CLASS[company, domain] ⊕ GATE[level]

import archetypesRaw from "../data/jd-v3/archetypes.json";
import rolesRaw from "../data/jd-v3/roles.json";
import baseRaw from "../data/jd-v3/base.json";
import hooksRaw from "../data/jd-v3/hooks.json";
import metaRaw from "../data/jd-v3/meta.json";

export const GENERATOR_VERSION = "jdgen-2026.10-v3";
export const DOMAINS: string[] = (metaRaw as any).domains;
export const LEVELS = ["CAMPUS", "EARLY", "MID", "SENIOR"] as const;
export type Level = (typeof LEVELS)[number];
export type RelClass = "C" | "I" | "A" | "X";
export const CLASS_LABEL: Record<RelClass, string> = { C: "CORE", I: "INTERNAL", A: "ADJACENT", X: "ATYPICAL" };

export interface Company {
  id: string; name: string; legal: string | null; sector: string; arche: string; industry: string | null;
  hired: string[]; top3: string[]; levels: string[]; levelEvidence: string | null; campus: string[]; internship: string[];
  confidence: string; status: string; libFlags: string | null; source: string; businessLines: string[] | null;
  programme: { name: string; levels: string[]; label: string } | null; companyEligibility: { text: string; label: string } | null;
  ladder: Record<string, string> | null; campusTitle: string | null; curatedFlags: string[]; curated: boolean;
  relevance: string; relevanceEvidence: string;
}
export interface Archetype {
  code: string; name: string; ladder: Record<string, string>; eligibility: { text: string; label: string }; regulatory: string;
  tools: string[]; conditionalCerts: string[]; businessLines: string[]; segments: string[]; metrics: string[]; locations: string;
  subSegments: string[]; relevance: Record<string, RelClass>;
}
export interface Role {
  id: string; domain: string; name: string; focus: string; byLevel: Record<string, { resp: string[]; title: string | null; source: string }>;
  entry: Level; skills: string[]; goodToHave: string | null; tools: string[]; atsKeywords: string[];
  certPreferred: string | null; certRequired: string | null; affinity: string[]; generic: boolean; origin: string;
}
export interface Base {
  id: string; domain: string; domainName: string; domainType: string; level: Level; levelLabel: string; experienceBand: string;
  titles: string[]; subAreas: string[]; summary: string; responsibilities: string[]; skills: { technical: string[]; behavioural: string[] };
  goodToHave: string; tools: string[]; experience: { text: string; minYears: number; maxYears: number; freshersEligible: boolean };
  education: string; academicCutOff: { code: string; note: string };

    preferredSpecialisations: string[]; requiredCertifications: string[]; softSkills: string[] };
}

// ---------- deterministic helpers ----------
export function seed(s: string): number { let h = 0x811c9dc5; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; } return h >>> 0; }
const pick = <T,>(arr: T[], n: number) => arr[n % arr.length];
const firstAlt = (s: string) => s.split(" / ")[0].split(" · ")[0].trim();
const stripSuffix = (s: string) => s.replace(/\s+[–-]\s+.*$/, "").trim();
const lcFirst = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + s.slice(1);
const ucFirst = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
const dedupe = (arr: string[]) => { const seen = new Set<string>(); return arr.filter(x => { const k = x.toLowerCase().trim(); if (!k || seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true; }); };
const PROPER = /^(Indian|PSU|FMCG|Big|EPC|ESG|AMC|NBFC|GCC|IT|SaaS|PR|E-commerce|Global|Domestic)\b/;
export const smartLower = (s: string) => s.split(" ").map(w => /^[A-Z0-9&-]{2,}$/.test(w) || /^[A-Z][a-z]*[A-Z]/.test(w) ? w : w.toLowerCase()).join(" ");
const aName = (n: string) => { const t = PROPER.test(n) ? n : lcFirst(n); return `${/^[aeiouAEIOU]/.test(t) || /^(FMCG|NBFC|ESG|EPC|AMC|IT)\b/.test(t) ? "an" : "a"} ${t}`; };
const article = (w: string) => (/^[aeiouAEIOU]/.test(w) ? "an" : "a");
const regToken = (r: string) => (r.match(/\b[A-Z][A-Z&]{1,}[A-Za-z]*\b/) || [""])[0];
const CRED = /(NISM-Series-[A-Z0-9-]+|IC-38|ICSI|Bar Council|AIBE|CISA|\bCA\b|\bCMA\b)/;
const FINSERV = new Set(["AR08","AR09","AR10","AR11","AR12","AR13","AR14","AR15","AR16","AR17","AR18","AR45"]);
const possessive = (co: string) => co === "the company" ? "the company's" : co.endsWith("s") ? `${co}'` : `${co}'s`;

// ---------- context ----------
export interface Context { kind: "company" | "other"; id: string; name: string; company: Company | null; arche: Archetype; sector: string;
  businessLines: string[]; segment: string | null; customers: string[]; }
export function contextFor(input: { companyId?: string; archetype?: string; segment?: string }): Context {
  if (input.companyId && input.companyId !== "other") {
    const c = COMPANY.get(input.companyId); if (!c) throw new Error(`Unknown company ${input.companyId}`);
    const a = ARCH.get(c.arche)!;
    const bl = c.businessLines?.length ? c.businessLines : [`${smartLower(c.sector)} business`];
    return { kind: "company", id: c.id, name: c.name, company: c, arche: a, sector: c.sector, businessLines: bl, segment: null, customers: a.segments };
  }
  const a = ARCH.get(input.archetype || "") ; if (!a) throw new Error("For 'Other', choose a company type (archetype).");
  const seg = input.segment && a.subSegments.includes(input.segment) ? input.segment : null;
  const bl = seg ? [`${smartLower(seg)} business`, ...a.businessLines] : a.businessLines;
  const segIdx = seg ? Math.min(a.subSegments.indexOf(seg), a.segments.length - 1) : 0;
  const segments = seg ? [a.segments[segIdx], ...a.segments.filter((_, i) => i !== segIdx)] : a.segments;
  return { kind: "other", customers: segments, id: `other-${a.code}${seg ? "-" + seg.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-") : ""}`, name: "the company", company: null, arche: a, sector: a.name, businessLines: bl, segment: seg };
}
export function relevanceOf(ctx: Context, domain: string): { cls: RelClass; evidence: string } {
  const i = DOMAINS.indexOf(domain); if (i < 0) throw new Error(`Unknown domain ${domain}`);
  if (ctx.company) {
    const legend = (metaRaw as any).evidenceLegend as Record<string, string>;
    return { cls: ctx.company.relevance[i] as RelClass, evidence: legend[ctx.company.relevanceEvidence.split(" ")[i]] || "" };
  }
  const cls = (ctx.arche.relevance[domain] as RelClass) || (["CON","IB","ENT","PPD"].includes(domain) ? "A" :
    ["HCM","AGB","RTL","RE","ECM","MED","ENR","INF","TEL","EDT"].includes(domain) ? "X" : "I");
  return { cls, evidence: `Archetype default (${ctx.arche.name}) – INFERENCE` };
}

// ---------- roles ----------
export function rolesFor(ctx: Context, domain: string, level: Level = "CAMPUS"): Role[] {
  const all = ROLES.filter(r => r.domain === domain);
  const matched = all.filter(r => r.affinity.includes(ctx.arche.code));
  const generic = all.filter(r => r.generic && !matched.includes(r));
  let list = [...matched, ...generic];
  if (!list.length) list = all.slice(0, 6);
  const { cls } = relevanceOf(ctx, domain);
  if (cls === "A" && ADJ_ROLE[domain]) { const adj = ROLE.get(ADJ_ROLE[domain]); if (adj) list = [adj, ...list.filter(r => r.id !== adj.id)]; }
  // Best fit first: archetype position in the role's affinity list, then the role's catalogue order.
  const lvi = LEVELS.indexOf(level);
  const rank = (r: Role) => { const i = r.affinity.indexOf(ctx.arche.code);
    return (i < 0 ? 99 : i) + (LEVELS.indexOf(r.entry) > lvi ? 50 : 0) + (TRAINEE.test(r.name) ? (lvi >= 2 ? 50 : lvi === 1 ? 5 : 0) : 0); };
  const head = cls === "A" && ADJ_ROLE[domain] ? list.slice(0, 1) : [];
  let rest = (head.length ? list.slice(1) : list).map((r, i) => ({ r, k: rank(r) * 100 + i })).sort((x, y) => x.k - y.k).map(x => x.r);
  // Among roles tied for best fit, rotate deterministically by company so peers in the same sector feature different roles.
  const best = rest.length ? rank(rest[0]) : 0;
  const tied = rest.filter(r => rank(r) === best && best < 99);
  if (tied.length > 1 && !(ctx.company?.curated)) {
    const k = seed(`${ctx.id}|${domain}|feature`) % tied.length;
    rest = [...tied.slice(k), ...tied.slice(0, k), ...rest.filter(r => !tied.includes(r))];
  }
  return [...head, ...rest].slice(0, 8);
}

// ---------- the card ----------
export interface JDCard {
  id: string; generatorVersion: string; contextKind: "company" | "other"; companyId: string; companyName: string; sector: string; archetype: { code: string; name: string };
  domain: string; domainName: string; level: Level; levelLabel: string; experienceBand: string;
  relevance: { class: RelClass; label: string; evidence: string }; banner: string | null;
  title: string; role: { id: string; name: string }; roleOptions: { id: string; name: string; title: string; focus: string }[];
  summary: string; responsibilities: string[]; skills: { technical: string[]; behavioural: string[] }; goodToHave: string; tools: string[];
  experience: string; education: string; eligibility: { code: string; note: string; label: string; source: string }; locations: string;
  campusPresence: string[]; certifications: { required: string; preferred: string; conditional: string[] };
  atsKeywords: string[]; mustHave: string[]; flags: string[]; disclaimer: string; fingerprint: string;
  scoring: { freshersRole: boolean; minExperienceMonths: number; roleFamily: string; requiredDegrees: string[]; preferredSpecialisations: string[]; softSkills: string[] };
  baseStatus: { code: string; label: string };
}

function titleFor(ctx: Context, cls: RelClass, level: Level, base: Base, role: Role, domain: string): string {
  const baseTitle = stripSuffix(firstAlt(base.titles[0] || "Associate"));
  if (cls === "A") return `${baseTitle} – ${ADJ_NAME[domain]}`;
  const ownTitle = role.byLevel[level]?.title || null;   // e.g. "Assistant Brand Manager" from the role library
  if (cls === "C") {
    const c = ctx.company;
    let lt: string | null = null;
    if (c?.ladder?.[level.charAt(0)]) lt = c.ladder[level.charAt(0)];
    else if (level === "CAMPUS" && c?.campusTitle) lt = c.campusTitle;
    else if (LADDER_AGNOSTIC.has(ctx.arche.code)) lt = ctx.arche.ladder[level.charAt(0)];
    if (lt) return `${firstAlt(lt)} – ${role.name}`;
    if (ownTitle) return ownTitle;
    return `${baseTitle} – ${role.name}`;
  }
  if (ownTitle) return `${ownTitle}${cls === "I" && !/in-house/i.test(ownTitle) ? " (in-house)" : ""}`;
  const sharesWord = role.name.split(/[\s/&(),-]+/).some(w => w.length >= 5 && baseTitle.toLowerCase().includes(w.toLowerCase()));
  const core = sharesWord ? baseTitle : `${baseTitle} – ${role.name}`;
  return `${core}${cls === "I" && !/in-house/i.test(core) ? " (in-house)" : ""}`;
}

interface Slots { bls: string[]; segs: string[]; metrics: string[]; loc: string; }
function slotsFor(ctx: Context, domain: string, cls: RelClass): Slots {
  const native = cls === "C" && ctx.arche.relevance[domain] === "C";
  const hint = BL_HINT[domain];
  const matched = hint ? ctx.businessLines.filter(b => hint.test(b)) : [];
  const bls = matched.length ? matched : (hint && ctx.kind === "company" ? [ctx.businessLines[0]] : ctx.businessLines);
  // HR and Legal serve internal stakeholders, so their "customers" never come from the company type.
  const segs = DOMAIN_CUSTOMERS[domain] && (!native || domain === "HR" || domain === "LEG") ? DOMAIN_CUSTOMERS[domain] : ctx.customers;
  const commercial = COMMERCIAL_ARCH.has(ctx.arche.code);
  const useArchMetric = native && (["CON","GM","BA"].includes(domain) || (commercial && ["SAL","MKT"].includes(domain)));
  return { bls, segs, metrics: useArchMetric ? ctx.arche.metrics : DOMAIN_METRICS[domain] || ctx.arche.metrics, loc: LOC_PHRASE[domain] || "assigned locations" };
}
function fill(tpl: string, ctx: Context, n: number, sl: Slots): string {
  const a = ctx.arche;
  if (!/\{co\}/.test(tpl)) tpl = /\{bl\}/.test(tpl) ? tpl.replace("{bl}", "{co}'s {bl}") : /\{seg\}/.test(tpl) ? `${tpl} at {co}` : `${tpl} for {co}'s {bl}`;
  return tpl.replace(/\{co\}'s/g, possessive(ctx.name)).replace(/\{co\}/g, ctx.name)
    .replace(/\{bl\}/g, pick(sl.bls, n)).replace(/\{seg\}/g, pick(sl.segs, n >>> 3))
    .replace(/\{metric\}/g, pick(sl.metrics, n >>> 5)).replace(/\{reg\}/g, a.regulatory).replace(/\{loc\}/g, sl.loc)
    .replace(/\{tool\}/g, pick(a.tools, n >>> 7));
}

export function generate(input: { companyId?: string; archetype?: string; segment?: string; domain: string; level: Level; roleId?: string }): JDCard {
  const ctx = contextFor(input);
  const { domain, level } = input;
  const base = BASEMAP.get(`${domain}|${level}`); if (!base) throw new Error(`No base JD for ${domain}|${level}`);
  const { cls, evidence } = relevanceOf(ctx, domain);
  const options = rolesFor(ctx, domain, level);
  const role = (input.roleId && ROLE.get(input.roleId)) || options[0];
  const s = seed(`${ctx.id}|${domain}|${level}|${role.id}`);
  const co = ctx.name, coP = possessive(co);
  const execBand = level === "CAMPUS" || level === "EARLY";

  // Summary
  const sl = slotsFor(ctx, domain, cls);
  const bl0 = sl.bls[0];
  const seg0 = sl.segs[0];
  const prog = ctx.company?.programme && level === "CAMPUS" && cls === "C" ? ` within the ${ctx.company.programme.name.split(" – ")[0].split(";")[0]}` : "";
  const where = ctx.kind === "company" ? `${co} (${ctx.sector})` : `${aName(ctx.arche.name)}${ctx.segment ? ` (${ctx.segment})` : ""}`;
  const lead = {
    C: `${role.name} role at ${where}, working on ${bl0} for ${seg0}${prog}.`,
    I: `In-house ${base.domainName.toLowerCase()} role (${role.name}) at ${where}, supporting ${coP} ${bl0}.`,
    A: `Closest equivalent at ${where} to ${article(base.domainName)} ${base.domainName} role: ${ADJ_NAME[domain]}, supporting ${coP} ${bl0}.`,
    X: `${ctx.kind === "company" ? co : "This type of company"} rarely hires MBAs into ${base.domainName}; this extrapolated JD describes the closest ${role.name} role, linked to ${bl0}.`,
  }[cls];
  const summary = `${lead} ${role.focus} ${LEVEL_FRAME[level]}`;

  // Responsibilities: scope + 3 company hooks + role / base duties
  const hookDomain = cls === "A" && ADJ_ROLE[domain] ? role.domain : domain;
  const hk = HOOKS[hookDomain][execBand ? "exec" : "lead"];
  const start = s % hk.length;
  const hooks = cls === "X"
    ? [`Apply ${base.domainName.toLowerCase()} skills where ${co === "the company" ? "the company" : co} needs them, for example in ${bl0} serving ${seg0}`]
    : [0, 1, 2].map(i => fill(hk[(start + i) % hk.length], ctx, s + i * 7919, hookDomain === domain ? sl : slotsFor(ctx, hookDomain, "C")));
  let roleLines: string[];
  const rl = role.byLevel[level] || role.byLevel[LEVELS.slice(0, LEVELS.indexOf(level) + 1).reverse().find(l => role.byLevel[l]) || role.entry];
  const rot = <T,>(arr: T[], k: number, n: number) => arr.length <= n ? arr.slice() : [...arr.slice(k % arr.length), ...arr.slice(0, k % arr.length)].slice(0, n);
  if (execBand) roleLines = rot(rl?.resp || [], s >>> 9, 5);
  else {
    const own = role.byLevel[level] ? role.byLevel[level].resp.slice(0, 3) : [
      `Set direction and standards for ${role.name.toLowerCase()} across ${coP} ${pick(sl.bls, s >>> 2)}`,
      `Coach the team that will ${lcFirst((role.byLevel[role.entry]?.resp[0] || role.focus).replace(/\.$/, ""))}`];
    roleLines = [...own, ...rot(base.responsibilities.slice(1), s >>> 11, 4)];
  }
  let responsibilities = dedupe([SCOPE[level], ...hooks, ...roleLines]);
  if (responsibilities.length < 8) responsibilities = dedupe([...responsibilities, ...base.responsibilities.slice(1)]);
  responsibilities = responsibilities.slice(0, 10);

  // Skills, tools, keywords, must-haves
  const technical = dedupe([...role.skills.slice(0, 4).map(ucFirst), ...base.skills.technical]).slice(0, 8);
  const behavioural = base.skills.behavioural;
  const tools = dedupe([...role.tools, ...ctx.arche.tools]).slice(0, 7);
  const coTokens = ctx.kind === "company"
    ? [co, ctx.sector, ctx.company?.programme ? (ctx.company.programme.name.match(/\(([A-Z]{2,6})\)/)?.[1] || "") : "", regToken(ctx.arche.regulatory)]
    : [ctx.arche.name, ctx.segment || "", regToken(ctx.arche.regulatory)];
  const atsKeywords = dedupe([...coTokens.filter(Boolean), ...role.atsKeywords, ...base.atsKeywords]).slice(0, 25);
  const roleMust = role.skills.find(k => !VAGUE_SKILL.test(k.trim())) || "";
  const mustHave = dedupe([...base.mustHave.slice(0, 4), ucFirst(roleMust)]).slice(0, 5);

  // Eligibility precedence: company (verified/secondary) > archetype > base level norm
  let elig = { code: base.academicCutOff.code, note: base.academicCutOff.note, label: "See note", source: "Base domain × level norm" };
  const notifBased = ["AR13", "AR23", "AR38"].includes(ctx.arche.code);
  if (cls === "C" && (level === "CAMPUS" || (level === "EARLY" && notifBased))) {
    if (ctx.company?.companyEligibility) elig = { code: base.academicCutOff.code, note: ctx.company.companyEligibility.text, label: ctx.company.companyEligibility.label, source: "Company-specific" };
    else elig = { code: base.academicCutOff.code, note: ctx.arche.eligibility.text, label: ctx.arche.eligibility.label, source: `Archetype norm (${ctx.arche.name})` };
  } else if (notifBased && cls === "C") {
    elig = { ...elig, note: `${elig.note} Lateral PSU, bank and regulator posts are notification-based, with post-qualification experience and age limits (e.g., one 2025-26 PSU notice: Manager 8 years and age ≤35) – SECONDARY.`, label: "SECONDARY" };
  }

  // Certifications (level-gated)
  let required = base.certifications.required;
  if (role.certRequired && cls === "C") required = /^None/.test(required) ? role.certRequired : `${required}; ${role.certRequired}`;
  if (level === "CAMPUS" && EXP_GATED.test(required)) required = required.replace(EXP_GATED, m => `${m} (candidate / in progress only at Campus)`);
  const basePref = base.certifications.preferred;
  const acr = (x: string) => (x.match(/\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]{1,}\b/g) || [x.split(/[\s(]/)[0]]);
  const extraPref = (role.certPreferred || "").split(";").map(x => x.trim()).filter(x => x && !acr(x).some(k => basePref.includes(k)));
  const preferred = [basePref, ...extraPref].filter(Boolean).join("; ");
  let baseCond = base.certifications.conditional;
  if ((domain === "FIN" || domain === "SAL") && !FINSERV.has(ctx.arche.code)) baseCond = baseCond.filter(c => !/NISM|IRDAI|IC-38/.test(c));
  const archCond = REGULATED_DOMAINS.has(domain) && cls === "C" ? ctx.arche.conditionalCerts.filter(c => { const k = (c.match(CRED) || [""])[0]; return !k || !baseCond.some(b => b.includes(k)); }) : [];
  const conditional = dedupe([...baseCond, ...archCond]);

  // Flags
  const flags: string[] = [];
  const banner = cls === "X" ? `FLAG — Atypical: ${ctx.kind === "company" ? co : "this company type"} rarely hires MBAs into ${base.domainName}; this JD is extrapolated.`
    : cls === "A" ? `Closest equivalent role at ${ctx.kind === "company" ? co : "this company type"}: ${ADJ_NAME[domain]} (not a classic ${base.domainName} role).`
    : cls === "I" ? `In-house function: ${base.domainName} supports ${coP} business; smaller team and internal clients.` : null;
  if (ctx.company && !ctx.company.levels.includes(level)) flags.push(`${co} is not recorded as hiring MBAs at ${LEVEL_LABEL[level]} level in the library; this level is extrapolated.`);
  if (ctx.company?.confidence === "Low") flags.push(`${co} is not yet matched to a placement report (library confidence: Low) – confirm MBA hiring before relying on this JD.`);
  if (LEVELS.indexOf(level) < LEVELS.indexOf(role.entry)) flags.push(`${role.name} is rarely hired at ${LEVEL_LABEL[level]} level; the JD shows the closest entry route.`);
  if (ctx.company && !ctx.company.curated) flags.push("Company-specific business lines are not yet curated; personalisation uses the library sector and company type (INFERENCE).");
  flags.push(...(ctx.company?.curatedFlags || []));
  // Library notes are shown unless they contain pay figures (compensation is excluded from JDs by design).
  if (ctx.company?.libFlags && !/(₹|LPA|lakh|\bCTC\b|salary|stipend)/i.test(ctx.company.libFlags)) flags.push(`Library note: ${ctx.company.libFlags}`);
  if (base.status.code === "A") flags.push(`Base ${base.domainName} JD at ${LEVEL_LABEL[level]} level is assumption-led (A).`);
  flags.push(`Relevance class ${CLASS_LABEL[cls]} – basis: ${evidence}.`);

  const title = titleFor(ctx, cls, level, base, role, domain);
  const disclaimer = ctx.kind === "company"
    ? `Illustrative sample based on ${coP} public hiring patterns — not an official JD.`
    : `Illustrative sample for a ${ctx.arche.name.toLowerCase()} — not an official JD of any company.`;
  const fpText = [title, summary, ...responsibilities.slice(0, 4), elig.note, required].join("|");
  const fingerprint = seed(fpText).toString(16).padStart(8, "0") + seed("#" + fpText + "#").toString(16).padStart(8, "0");   // 64-bit
  return {
    id: `${ctx.id}|${domain}|${level}|${role.id}`, generatorVersion: GENERATOR_VERSION, contextKind: ctx.kind, companyId: ctx.id, companyName: ctx.kind === "company" ? co : `Other – ${ctx.arche.name}`,
    sector: ctx.sector, archetype: { code: ctx.arche.code, name: ctx.arche.name },
    domain, domainName: base.domainName, level, levelLabel: LEVEL_LABEL[level], experienceBand: base.experienceBand,
    relevance: { class: cls, label: CLASS_LABEL[cls], evidence }, banner, title, role: { id: role.id, name: role.name },
    roleOptions: options.map(r => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, title: titleFor(ctx, cls, level, base, r, domain), focus: r.focus })),
    summary, responsibilities, skills: { technical, behavioural }, goodToHave: role.goodToHave && !base.goodToHave.toLowerCase().includes(role.goodToHave.toLowerCase().split(";")[0].trim()) ? `${ucFirst(role.goodToHave.replace(/\.$/, ""))}; ${lcFirst(base.goodToHave)}` : base.goodToHave,
    tools, experience: base.experience.text, education: base.education, eligibility: elig, locations: ctx.arche.locations,
    campusPresence: ctx.company ? [...ctx.company.campus, ...ctx.company.internship.map(x => `${x} (internships)`)] : [],
    certifications: { required, preferred, conditional }, atsKeywords, mustHave, flags, disclaimer, fingerprint,
    scoring: { freshersRole: base.scoring.freshersRole, minExperienceMonths: base.scoring.minExperienceMonths, roleFamily: base.scoring.roleFamily,
      // Degree gate only for CORE campus roles (same rule as v2); never for INTERNAL/ADJACENT/ATYPICAL extrapolations.
      requiredDegrees: cls === "C" ? base.scoring.requiredDegrees : [], preferredSpecialisations: base.scoring.preferredSpecialisations, softSkills: base.scoring.softSkills },
    baseStatus: { code: base.status.code, label: base.status.label },
  };
}

// Convenience for pickers
export function listCompanies() { return COMPANIES.map(c => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, sector: c.sector, archetype: c.arche })); }
export function listArchetypes() { return ARCHETYPES.map(a => ({ code: a.code, name: a.name, segments: a.subSegments })); }
```

### Task 3 — Adapter: `src/lib/jdLibraryV3.ts`

```ts
// Target JD Database v3 — Company × Domain × Level × Role, generated on demand by ./jdgen.
// Sample JDs skip LLM extraction: JDFacts are derived deterministically, so the same choice always scores the same way.
import { z } from "zod";
import { generate, listCompanies, listArchetypes, DOMAINS, LEVELS, GENERATOR_VERSION, COMPANIES, ARCHETYPES, ROLES, type JDCard } from "./jdgen";
import { JDFacts } from "./schemas";
import { normalise } from "./skills";
import { JD_LIBRARY } from "./jdLibrary";

export const LIBRARY_VERSION_V3 = "jdlib-2026.10-v3";
export { GENERATOR_VERSION };
const COMPANY_IDS = new Set(COMPANIES.map(c => c.id));
const ARCH_CODES = new Set(ARCHETYPES.map(a => a.code));
const ROLE_IDS = new Set(ROLES.map(r => r.id));

// Input from the picker (query string or form). companyId "other" requires an archetype; segment and role are optional.
export const SampleChoiceV3 = z.object({
  companyId: z.string().min(1).max(120).transform(s => s.trim().toLowerCase()),
  archetype: z.string().max(8).optional().transform(s => (s ? s.trim().toUpperCase() : undefined)),
  segment: z.string().max(60).optional(),
  domain: z.string().transform(s => s.trim().toUpperCase()),
  level: z.string().transform(s => s.trim().toUpperCase()),
  roleId: z.string().max(80).optional(),
}).superRefine((v, ctx) => {
  if (v.companyId === "other") { if (!v.archetype || !ARCH_CODES.has(v.archetype)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "For 'Other', choose a company type." }); }
  else if (!COMPANY_IDS.has(v.companyId)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Unknown company. Choose one from the list or 'Other'." });
  if (!DOMAINS.includes(v.domain)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Choose a target domain." });
  if (!(LEVELS as readonly string[]).includes(v.level)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Choose a career level." });
  if (v.roleId && !ROLE_IDS.has(v.roleId)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Unknown role." });
});
export type SampleChoiceV3 = z.infer<typeof SampleChoiceV3>;

export function getCardV3(choice: SampleChoiceV3): JDCard {
  const roleOk = choice.roleId && ROLES.find(r => r.id === choice.roleId)?.domain === choice.domain ? choice.roleId : undefined;
  return choice.companyId === "other"
    ? generate({ archetype: choice.archetype, segment: choice.segment, domain: choice.domain, level: choice.level as any, roleId: roleOk })
    : generate({ companyId: choice.companyId, domain: choice.domain, level: choice.level as any, roleId: roleOk });
}

// Picker data: companies (searchable), "Other" company types with segments, domains and levels.
export function getPickerDataV3() {
  const domainNames = new Map(JD_LIBRARY.map(j => [j.domainCode, j.domain]));
  return {
    libraryVersion: LIBRARY_VERSION_V3, generatorVersion: GENERATOR_VERSION,
    companies: listCompanies(), otherTypes: listArchetypes(),
    domains: DOMAINS.map(code => ({ code, name: domainNames.get(code) ?? code })),
    levels: [
      { code: "CAMPUS", label: "Campus", band: "0–2 years", hint: "Final-year MBA/PGDM/MMS student or recent graduate" },
      { code: "EARLY", label: "Early", band: "2–5 years", hint: "Early lateral; one-year MBA with under 5 years" },
      { code: "MID", label: "Mid", band: "5–10 years", hint: "Manager or senior manager" },
      { code: "SENIOR", label: "Senior", band: "10+ years", hint: "Head, director, P&L or function leader" },
    ],
  };
}

const stripParens = (s: string) => s.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, "").trim();
export function toJDFactsV3(c: JDCard): JDFacts {
  const must = c.mustHave.slice(0, 5);
  const seen = new Set(must.map(normalise));
  const preferred: string[] = [];
  for (const k of [...c.atsKeywords.slice(0, 25), ...c.skills.technical.map(stripParens)]) {
    const n = normalise(k);
    if (!n || seen.has(n) || k === c.companyName || k === c.sector) continue;   // company tokens are context, not skills
    seen.add(n); preferred.push(k);
  }
  return JDFacts.parse({
    title: c.title,
    roleFamily: c.scoring.roleFamily,
    freshersRole: c.scoring.freshersRole,
    minExperienceMonths: c.scoring.minExperienceMonths,
    requiredDegrees: c.scoring.requiredDegrees,
    preferredSpecialisations: c.scoring.preferredSpecialisations,
    requiredCertifications: [],                  // certifications are advisory notes, never knockouts
    hardSkills: [...must.map(name => ({ name, mustHave: true })), ...preferred.map(name => ({ name, mustHave: false }))],
    softSkills: c.scoring.softSkills,
  });
}

export function toJDTextV3(c: JDCard): string {
  return [
    `${c.title} · ${c.companyName} · ${c.domainName} — ${c.levelLabel} (${c.experienceBand})`,
    c.banner ? `Note: ${c.banner}` : "",
    `About the role: ${c.summary}`,
    `Key responsibilities:\n${c.responsibilities.map(r => `- ${r}`).join("\n")}`,
    `Technical skills: ${c.skills.technical.join("; ")}`,
    `Behavioural skills: ${c.skills.behavioural.join("; ")}`,
    `Good to have: ${c.goodToHave}`,
    `Tools: ${c.tools.join("; ")}`,
    `Experience: ${c.experience}`,
    `Education: ${c.education}`,
    `Academic criteria (${c.eligibility.code}, ${c.eligibility.label}): ${c.eligibility.note}`,
    `Certifications — required: ${c.certifications.required}`,
    `Certifications — preferred: ${c.certifications.preferred}`,
    c.certifications.conditional.length ? `Certifications — conditional:\n${c.certifications.conditional.map(x => `- ${x}`).join("\n")}` : "",
    `Keywords: ${c.atsKeywords.join(", ")}`,
    c.disclaimer,
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
}

// Shown beside a result. Advisory only — never folded into the score.
export function sampleNotesV3(c: JDCard) {
  return { id: c.id, libraryVersion: LIBRARY_VERSION_V3, generatorVersion: GENERATOR_VERSION, company: c.companyName, domain: c.domainName, level: c.levelLabel,
    role: c.role, relevance: c.relevance, banner: c.banner, eligibility: c.eligibility, campusPresence: c.campusPresence,
    conditionalCertifications: c.certifications.conditional, flags: c.flags, disclaimer: c.disclaimer, baseStatus: c.baseStatus };
}

// Preview payload for the UI (scoring internals omitted).
export function toPreviewV3(c: JDCard) {
  const { scoring, fingerprint, ...rest } = c;
  return rest;
}
```

### Task 4 — Intake: replace `src/lib/jdIntake.ts`

The `sample` case now accepts the v3 fields first and falls back to the v2 `jdId`. Link, upload and paste handling (including the SSRF guards) are unchanged.

```ts
// Resolves the Target JD for /api/check from one of: sample (Career Level × Target Domain), link (URL), upload (PDF/DOCX), paste (text).
import "server-only";
import { lookup } from "node:dns/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import { MAX_BYTES, sniffType } from "./security";
import { parseResume } from "./parse";
import { getTargetJD, getTargetJDFor, toJDFacts, toJDText, sampleNotes, LIBRARY_VERSION } from "./jdLibrary";
import { SampleChoiceV3, getCardV3, toJDFactsV3, toJDTextV3, sampleNotesV3, LIBRARY_VERSION_V3 } from "./jdLibraryV3";
import type { JDFacts } from "./schemas";

export type JDSource = "sample" | "link" | "upload" | "paste";

export class JDInputError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public status = 400) { super(message); }
}

export interface ResolvedJD {
  source: JDSource;
  text: string;                       // full JD text (untrusted unless source === "sample")
  facts: JDFacts | null;              // precomputed for sample JDs; null → run LLM extraction as before
  sampleId: string | null;
  libraryVersion: string | null;
  urlHost: string | null;             // store the host only, never the page HTML
  notes: ReturnType<typeof sampleNotes> | ReturnType<typeof sampleNotesV3> | null;
}

const MIN_JD_CHARS = 200;
const MAX_JD_CHARS = 20_000;
const LINK_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const LINK_MAX_BYTES = 1_500_000;
const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;

export async function resolveJD(form: FormData): Promise<ResolvedJD> {
  const source = String(form.get("jdSource") ?? "paste") as JDSource;
  switch (source) {
    case "sample": {
      // v3 picker: company (or "other" + company type) × domain × level, optional role.
      if (form.get("jdCompany")) {
        const parsed = SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({
          companyId: String(form.get("jdCompany") ?? ""), archetype: (form.get("jdArchetype") as string) || undefined,
          segment: (form.get("jdSegment") as string) || undefined, domain: String(form.get("jdDomain") ?? ""),
          level: String(form.get("jdLevel") ?? ""), roleId: (form.get("jdRole") as string) || undefined });
        if (!parsed.success) throw new JDInputError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Choose a company, domain and level.");
        const card = getCardV3(parsed.data);
        return { source, text: toJDTextV3(card), facts: toJDFactsV3(card), sampleId: card.id, libraryVersion: LIBRARY_VERSION_V3, urlHost: null, notes: sampleNotesV3(card) };
      }
      // v2 picker (kept for compatibility): jdId (e.g. "CON-CAMPUS"); jdDomain + jdLevel are accepted as a fallback.
      const j = getTargetJD(String(form.get("jdId") ?? "")) ??
        getTargetJDFor(String(form.get("jdDomain") ?? ""), String(form.get("jdLevel") ?? ""));
      if (!j) throw new JDInputError("Choose a career level and a target domain.");
      return { source, text: toJDText(j), facts: toJDFacts(j), sampleId: j.id, libraryVersion: LIBRARY_VERSION, urlHost: null, notes: sampleNotes(j) };
    }
    case "link": {
      const { text, host } = await fetchJobPage(String(form.get("jdUrl") ?? "").trim());
      return external(source, text, host);
    }
    case "upload": {
      const f = form.get("jdFile");
      if (!(f instanceof File) || f.size === 0) throw new JDInputError("Attach the JD as a PDF or DOCX file.");
      if (f.size > MAX_BYTES) throw new JDInputError("The JD file must be 2 MB or smaller.");
      const buf = Buffer.from(await f.arrayBuffer());
      const type = sniffType(buf);
      if (!type) throw new JDInputError("Upload the JD as PDF or DOCX (no macro-enabled files).");
      return external(source, (await parseResume(buf, type)).text, null);
    }
    case "paste":
      return external(source, String(form.get("jd") ?? ""), null);
    default:
      throw new JDInputError("Unknown JD source.");
  }
}

function external(source: JDSource, raw: string, urlHost: string | null): ResolvedJD {
  const text = raw.replace(/\r/g, "").trim().slice(0, MAX_JD_CHARS);
  if (text.length < MIN_JD_CHARS) {
    throw new JDInputError(source === "link"
      ? "We couldn't read enough of that page. Some job boards need a login or block automated access. Paste the JD text or upload it instead."
      : "The JD looks too short. Include the full job description (at least 200 characters).");
  }
  return { source, text, facts: null, sampleId: null, libraryVersion: null, urlHost, notes: null };
}

// ---------- Link intake with SSRF protection ----------
async function fetchJobPage(input: string): Promise<{ text: string; host: string }> {
  let url: URL;
  try { url = new URL(input); } catch { throw new JDInputError("Enter the full job link, starting with https://"); }
  for (let hop = 0; hop <= MAX_REDIRECTS; hop++) {
    await assertPublicHttps(url);
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      redirect: "manual",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(LINK_TIMEOUT_MS),
      headers: {
        "user-agent": "MyCareerCompany-ResumeChecker/1.0 (+https://www.mycareercompany.com)",
        accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,text/plain;q=0.9,application/pdf;q=0.8",
      },
    }).catch(() => { throw new JDInputError("That link didn't respond in time. Paste or upload the JD instead."); });
    if (res.status >= 300 && res.status < 400) {
      const loc = res.headers.get("location");
      if (!loc) break;
      url = new URL(loc, url);
      continue;
    }
    if (!res.ok) throw new JDInputError(`That page returned an error (${res.status}). Paste or upload the JD instead.`);
    const buf = await readCapped(res, LINK_MAX_BYTES);
    const ctype = (res.headers.get("content-type") ?? "").toLowerCase();
    const sniffed = sniffType(buf);
    if (sniffed) return { text: (await parseResume(buf, sniffed)).text, host: url.hostname };
    if (!/text\/html|application\/xhtml|text\/plain/.test(ctype)) throw new JDInputError("That link isn't a web page or PDF we can read.");
    const body = buf.toString("utf8");
    return { text: ctype.includes("text/plain") ? body : htmlToJobText(body), host: url.hostname };
  }
  throw new JDInputError("That link redirects too many times. Paste or upload the JD instead.");
}

async function assertPublicHttps(url: URL): Promise<void> {
  if (url.protocol !== "https:") throw new JDInputError("Only https:// links are supported.");
  if (url.username || url.password) throw new JDInputError("Links with embedded credentials aren't supported.");
  if (url.port && url.port !== "443") throw new JDInputError("Links with custom ports aren't supported.");
  const host = url.hostname.replace(/^\[|\]$/g, "");
  let addrs: { address: string }[];
  if (isIP(host)) addrs = [{ address: host }];
  else {
    try { addrs = await lookup(host, { all: true, verbatim: true }); }
    catch { throw new JDInputError("We couldn't find that website. Check the link."); }
  }
  if (!addrs.length || addrs.some(a => isPrivateIP(a.address))) throw new JDInputError("That link points to a private network address.");
}

export function isPrivateIP(ip: string): boolean {
  const v = ip.toLowerCase();
  if (v.includes(":")) {
    if (v.startsWith("::ffff:")) return isPrivateIP(v.slice(7));
    return v === "::" || v === "::1" || /^f[cd]/.test(v) || /^fe[89ab]/.test(v);
  }
  const [a, b] = v.split(".").map(Number);
  return a === 0 || a === 10 || a === 127 || a >= 224 ||
    (a === 100 && b >= 64 && b <= 127) || (a === 169 && b === 254) ||
    (a === 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) || (a === 192 && b === 168) || (a === 198 && (b === 18 || b === 19));
}

async function readCapped(res: Response, max: number): Promise<Buffer> {
  if (Number(res.headers.get("content-length") ?? 0) > max) throw new JDInputError("That page is too large to read.");
  if (!res.body) return Buffer.alloc(0);
  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    total += value.byteLength;
    if (total > max) { await reader.cancel(); throw new JDInputError("That page is too large to read."); }
    chunks.push(value);
  }
  return Buffer.concat(chunks);
}

// Prefer schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD (used by many careers sites); fall back to visible text.
export function htmlToJobText(html: string): string {
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/<script[^>]*type=["']application\/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)) {
    try {
      const data: unknown = JSON.parse(m[1].trim());
      const items = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data]).flatMap((d: any) => (d && d["@graph"]) ? d["@graph"] : [d]);
      const jp: any = items.find((d: any) => ([] as unknown[]).concat(d?.["@type"] ?? []).includes("JobPosting"));
      if (jp?.description) {
        const exp = jp.experienceRequirements;
        return [
          jp.title ? String(jp.title) : "",
          jp.hiringOrganization?.name ? `Company: ${jp.hiringOrganization.name}` : "",
          stripTags(decodeEntities(String(jp.description))),
          jp.qualifications ? `Qualifications: ${stripTags(decodeEntities(String(jp.qualifications)))}` : "",
          exp ? `Experience: ${typeof exp === "string" ? exp : JSON.stringify(exp)}` : "",
        ].filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
      }
    } catch { /* ignore malformed JSON-LD */ }
  }
  const main = html.match(/<(main|article)\b[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/i)?.[0] ?? html.match(/<body\b[\s\S]*<\/body>/i)?.[0] ?? html;
  return stripTags(main);
}

function stripTags(s: string): string {
  return decodeEntities(
    s.replace(/<(script|style|noscript|svg|nav|footer|header|form)\b[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<br\s*\/?>|<\/(p|div|li|h[1-6]|tr|section)>/gi, "\n")
      .replace(/<li\b[^>]*>/gi, "- ")
      .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " "),
  ).replace(/[ \t\f\v]+/g, " ").replace(/\n[ \t]*/g, "\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
}

function decodeEntities(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ").replace(/&lt;/g, "<").replace(/&gt;/g, ">").replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;|&apos;/g, "'").replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, n) => String.fromCodePoint(Number(n)))
    .replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, (_, h) => String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(h, 16))).replace(/&amp;/g, "&");
}
```

```ts
// GET /resumechecker/api/jds/v3 → picker data: companies, "Other" company types (with segments), domains and levels.
// Contains no personal data, so it does not require login.
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getPickerDataV3 } from "@/lib/jdLibraryV3";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET() {
  return NextResponse.json(getPickerDataV3(), { headers: { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=86400" } });
}
```

`src/app/api/jds/v3/card/route.ts`:

```ts
// GET /resumechecker/api/jds/v3/card?company=hindustan-unilever&domain=MKT&level=CAMPUS[&role=MKT:brand-management]
// GET /resumechecker/api/jds/v3/card?company=other&type=AR11&segment=SME%20banking&domain=SAL&level=MID
// Returns one generated JD card for preview (scoring internals omitted). Deterministic, so it is cacheable.
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { SampleChoiceV3, getCardV3, toPreviewV3, sampleNotesV3 } from "@/lib/jdLibraryV3";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const q = new URL(req.url).searchParams;
  const parsed = SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({
    companyId: q.get("company") ?? "", archetype: q.get("type") ?? undefined, segment: q.get("segment") ?? undefined,
    domain: q.get("domain") ?? "", level: q.get("level") ?? "", roleId: q.get("role") ?? undefined });
  if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid choice" }, { status: 400 });
  const card = getCardV3(parsed.data);
  return NextResponse.json({ jd: toPreviewV3(card), notes: sampleNotesV3(card) }, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=86400" } });
}
```

### Task 6 — Picker: replace `src/components/TargetJDPicker.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";
// Target JD picker (v3): (1) choose a sample by Company (or Other + company type) × Target Domain × Career Level, then a role;
// (2) share a JD link; (3) upload or paste a JD. Renders form fields only; the parent <form> submits them to /resumechecker/api/check.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";

type Level = { code: string; label: string; band: string; hint: string };
type Company = { id: string; name: string; sector: string; archetype: string };
type OtherType = { code: string; name: string; segments: string[] };
type Domain = { code: string; name: string };
type RoleOption = { id: string; name: string; title: string; focus: string };
type Preview = {
  jd: { id: string; title: string; companyName: string; domainName: string; levelLabel: string; experienceBand: string; summary: string;
    responsibilities: string[]; mustHave: string[]; experience: string; education: string; locations: string;
    certifications: { required: string; preferred: string; conditional: string[] }; roleOptions: RoleOption[]; role: { id: string; name: string };
    relevance: { class: string; label: string }; banner: string | null };
  notes: { eligibility: { code: string; note: string; label: string; source: string }; campusPresence: string[]; flags: string[]; disclaimer: string };
};

const API = "/resumechecker/api/jds/v3";
const C = { green: "#073D32", gold: "#D4AF7C", ivory: "#F8F6EF", ink: "#2B2B2B", greenTint: "#DCE9E3", goldTint: "#F4E8D4" };
const field: CSSProperties = { display: "block", width: "100%", padding: 8, margin: "4px 0 12px", border: `1px solid ${C.gold}`, borderRadius: 6, font: "inherit" };
const label: CSSProperties = { fontWeight: 600, color: C.green, fontSize: 14 };
const CLASS_HINT: Record<string, string> = { C: "core hiring area", I: "in-house function", A: "closest equivalent role", X: "rarely hired — extrapolated" };

export default function TargetJDPicker() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"sample" | "link" | "upload">("sample");
  const [uploadMode, setUploadMode] = useState<"file" | "paste">("file");
  const [data, setData] = useState<{ companies: Company[]; otherTypes: OtherType[]; domains: Domain[]; levels: Level[] } | null>(null);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [companyId, setCompanyId] = useState("");
  const [otherType, setOtherType] = useState("");
  const [segment, setSegment] = useState("");
  const [domain, setDomain] = useState("");
  const [level, setLevel] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState("");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(API).then(r => r.json()).then(d => { setData(d); setError(""); })
      .catch(() => setError("Couldn't load the sample JD list. Use a link or upload instead."));
  }, []);

  const matches = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || query.trim().length < 2) return [];
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return data.companies.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.sector.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 12);
  }, [data, query]);
  const chosen = data?.companies.find(c => c.id === companyId);
  const otherInfo = data?.otherTypes.find(t => t.code === otherType);
  const ready = !!domain && !!level && (companyId === "other" ? !!otherType : !!companyId);

  // A new company, domain or level resets the role so the best-fit role is featured again.
  useEffect(() => { setRole(""); }, [companyId, otherType, segment, domain, level]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) { setPreview(null); return; }
    const q = new URLSearchParams({ company: companyId, domain, level });
    if (companyId === "other") { q.set("type", otherType); if (segment) q.set("segment", segment); }
    if (role) q.set("role", role);
    fetch(`${API}/card?${q}`).then(r => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).then(setPreview).catch(() => setPreview(null));
  }, [ready, companyId, otherType, segment, domain, level, role]);

  const source = tab === "upload" ? (uploadMode === "file" ? "upload" : "paste") : tab;
  const tabBtn = (t: typeof tab, text: string) => (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab(t)} aria-pressed={tab === t}
      style={{ padding: "8px 14px", marginRight: 8, borderRadius: 6, cursor: "pointer", border: `1px solid ${C.green}`,
        background: tab === t ? C.green : "transparent", color: tab === t ? C.ivory : C.green, fontWeight: 600 }}>{text}</button>
  );
  const levelInfo = data?.levels.find(l => l.code === level);

  return (
    <fieldset style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.gold}`, borderRadius: 8, padding: 16, margin: "16px 0", color: C.ink }}>
      <legend style={{ ...label, fontSize: 16, padding: "0 6px" }}>Target JD</legend>
      <input type="hidden" name="jdSource" value={source} />
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {tabBtn("sample", "Choose company, domain & level")}{tabBtn("link", "Share a JD link")}{tabBtn("upload", "Upload or paste a JD")}
      </div>

      {tab === "sample" && (
        <div>
          {error && <p style={{ color: "crimson" }}>{error}</p>}
          <input type="hidden" name="jdCompany" value={companyId} />
          <input type="hidden" name="jdArchetype" value={companyId === "other" ? otherType : ""} />
          <input type="hidden" name="jdSegment" value={companyId === "other" ? segment : ""} />
          <input type="hidden" name="jdDomain" value={domain} />
          <input type="hidden" name="jdLevel" value={level} />
          <input type="hidden" name="jdRole" value={role || preview?.jd.role.id || ""} />

          <label style={label}>Target company
            <input style={field} value={chosen ? chosen.name : companyId === "other" ? "Other (not in the list)" : query}
              onChange={e => { setQuery(e.target.value); setCompanyId(""); }} placeholder="Start typing a company name, or choose Other" aria-autocomplete="list" />
          </label>
          {!companyId && query.trim().length >= 2 && (
            <ul role="listbox" style={{ listStyle: "none", margin: "-8px 0 12px", padding: 0, border: `1px solid ${C.gold}`, borderRadius: 6, maxHeight: 240, overflowY: "auto" }}>
              {matches.map(c => (
                <li key={c.id} role="option" aria-selected={false} onClick={() => { setCompanyId(c.id); setQuery(""); }}
                  style={{ padding: "6px 10px", cursor: "pointer", borderBottom: `1px solid ${C.goldTint}` }}>
                  <b>{c.name}</b> <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#666" }}>{c.sector}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
              <li role="option" aria-selected={false} onClick={() => { setCompanyId("other"); setQuery(""); }} style={{ padding: "6px 10px", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 600, color: C.green }}>
                Other — my company is not in the list
              </li>
            </ul>
          )}
          {(chosen || companyId === "other") && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { setCompanyId(""); setOtherType(""); setSegment(""); }} style={{ marginTop: -8, marginBottom: 12, fontSize: 12 }}>Change company</button>
          )}
          {companyId === "other" && data && (
            <>
              <label style={label}>What type of company is it?
                <select style={field} required value={otherType} onChange={e => { setOtherType(e.target.value); setSegment(""); }}>
                  <option value="">Choose the closest company type</option>
                  {data.otherTypes.map(t => <option key={t.code} value={t.code}>{t.name}</option>)}
                </select>
              </label>
              {otherInfo && (
                <label style={label}>Business segment (optional)
                  <select style={field} value={segment} onChange={e => setSegment(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="">Any</option>
                    {otherInfo.segments.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </label>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          <label style={label}>Target domain
            <select style={field} required value={domain} onChange={e => setDomain(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Choose a target domain</option>
              {data?.domains.map(d => <option key={d.code} value={d.code}>{d.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label style={label}>Career level
            <select style={field} required value={level} onChange={e => setLevel(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Choose your career level</option>
              {data?.levels.map(l => <option key={l.code} value={l.code}>{l.label} ({l.band})</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          {levelInfo && <p style={{ margin: "-6px 0 12px", fontSize: 13 }}>{levelInfo.hint}. Choose by total full-time experience, not job title.</p>}
          {preview && preview.jd.roleOptions.length > 1 && (
            <div style={{ margin: "0 0 12px" }}>
              <span style={label}>Role</span>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6, marginTop: 4 }}>
                {preview.jd.roleOptions.map(r => (
                  <button type="button" key={r.id} onClick={() => setRole(r.id)} title={r.focus} aria-pressed={preview.jd.role.id === r.id}
                    style={{ padding: "4px 10px", borderRadius: 14, border: `1px solid ${C.green}`, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 13,
                      background: preview.jd.role.id === r.id ? C.green : C.ivory, color: preview.jd.role.id === r.id ? C.ivory : C.green }}>{r.name}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {preview && <PreviewCard p={preview} />}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === "link" && (
        <label style={label}>Job link (https://)
          <input style={field} type="url" name="jdUrl" required pattern="https://.*" placeholder="https://careers.example.com/jobs/12345" />
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, fontSize: 13, color: C.ink }}>Some job boards need a login or block automated reading. If the link fails, paste or upload the JD instead.</span>
        </label>
      )}

      {tab === "upload" && (
        <div>
          <label style={{ marginRight: 16 }}><input type="radio" checked={uploadMode === "file"} onChange={() => setUploadMode("file")} /> Upload a file</label>
          <label><input type="radio" checked={uploadMode === "paste"} onChange={() => setUploadMode("paste")} /> Paste the text</label>
          {uploadMode === "file"
            ? <input style={field} type="file" name="jdFile" accept=".pdf,.docx" required />
            : <textarea style={field} name="jd" rows={10} minLength={200} required placeholder="Paste the full job description" />}
        </div>
      )}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function PreviewCard({ p }: { p: Preview }) {
  const { jd, notes } = p;
  return (
    <div style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.green}`, borderRadius: 8, overflow: "hidden", marginTop: 4 }}>
      <div style={{ background: C.green, color: C.ivory, padding: "10px 14px" }}>
        <b style={{ color: C.gold }}>{jd.title}</b>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{jd.companyName} · {jd.domainName} — {jd.levelLabel} ({jd.experienceBand}) · {jd.relevance.label}: {CLASS_HINT[jd.relevance.class]}</div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ padding: "10px 14px", fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
        {jd.banner && <p style={{ margin: "0 0 8px", padding: 8, background: C.goldTint, borderRadius: 6 }}>{jd.banner}</p>}
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 8px" }}>{jd.summary}</p>
        <ul style={{ margin: "0 0 8px 18px", padding: 0 }}>{jd.responsibilities.slice(0, 5).map(r => <li key={r}>{r}</li>)}</ul>
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 4px" }}><b>Must-have skills:</b> {jd.mustHave.join("; ")}</p>
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 4px" }}><b>Experience:</b> {jd.experience}</p>
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 4px" }}><b>Education:</b> {jd.education}</p>
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 4px" }}><b>Academic criteria ({notes.eligibility.label}):</b> {notes.eligibility.note}</p>
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 4px" }}><b>Certifications:</b> required — {jd.certifications.required}; preferred — {jd.certifications.preferred}</p>
        {notes.campusPresence.length > 0 && <p style={{ margin: "0 0 4px" }}><b>Recruits from (library):</b> {notes.campusPresence.join(", ")}</p>}
        {jd.certifications.conditional.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ margin: "0 0 8px", padding: 8, background: C.goldTint, borderRadius: 6 }}>
            <b>Only if your target role involves these activities:</b>
            <ul style={{ margin: "4px 0 0 18px", padding: 0 }}>{jd.certifications.conditional.map(c => <li key={c}>{c}</li>)}</ul>
          </div>
        )}
        {notes.flags.map(f => <p key={f} style={{ margin: "0 0 6px", color: "#6E5328", fontSize: 13 }}>FLAG: {f}</p>)}
        <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 0", fontSize: 12, color: "#666" }}>{notes.disclaimer}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

The company list (835 entries, about 60 KB) is loaded once and filtered in the browser after two characters. If you prefer server-side search, add `?q=` to the v3 route and return the first 20 matches; keep the "Other" option always visible.

### Task 7 — Tests: `tests/jdV3.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";

import { SampleChoiceV3, getCardV3, getPickerDataV3, toJDFactsV3, toJDTextV3, sampleNotesV3 } from "../src/lib/jdLibraryV3";
import { score } from "../src/lib/scoring";

const EXP_GATED = /\b(CFA charter|certified FRM|PMP|PgMP|SHRM-SCP|CBAP|CCBA|MRICS|FRICS|CFP)\b(?! \(candidate)/;
const pick = (n: number) => COMPANIES[(n * 97) % COMPANIES.length];

describe("v3 database coverage", () => {
  it("has 835 companies, 45 company types, 236 roles and every domain has roles", () => {

    expect(ARCHETYPES.length).toBe(45);

  });
  it("every company × domain × level generates a card for 40 sampled companies (4,480 cards)", () => {
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) for (const d of DOMAINS) for (const l of LEVELS) { const c = generate({ companyId: pick(i).id, domain: d, level: l }); expect(c.responsibilities.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8); n++; }
    expect(n).toBe(4480);
  });
  it("generation is deterministic", () => {
    const a = generate({ companyId: "hindustan-unilever", domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" });
    const b = generate({ companyId: "hindustan-unilever", domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" });
    expect(JSON.stringify(a)).toBe(JSON.stringify(b));
  });
});

describe("personalisation", () => {
  it("JDs differ by company for the same domain and level, and name the company", () => {
    const ids = ["hindustan-unilever", "itc", "nestle-india", "dabur", "marico"];
    const cards = ids.map(id => generate({ companyId: id, domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" }));
    expect(new Set(cards.map(c => c.fingerprint)).size).toBe(ids.length);
    for (const c of cards) { expect(c.summary).toContain(c.companyName); expect(c.responsibilities.filter(r => r.includes(c.companyName)).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2); }
  });
  it("uses company programmes and verified eligibility where they exist", () => {
    expect(generate({ companyId: "hindustan-unilever", domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" }).title).toContain("UFLP");
    expect(generate({ companyId: "itc", domain: "SAL", level: "CAMPUS" }).title).toContain("AUT");
    const coal = generate({ companyId: "coal-india", domain: "HR", level: "CAMPUS" });
    expect(coal.eligibility.note).toContain("60%");
    expect(coal.eligibility.source).toBe("Company-specific");
    expect(generate({ companyId: "tcs", domain: "ITS", level: "CAMPUS" }).eligibility.note).toContain("backlog");
  });
  it("classes reframe atypical and adjacent domains with banners", () => {
    const adj = generate({ companyId: "tata-administrative-services", domain: "IB", level: "EARLY" });
    expect(adj.relevance.class).toBe("A"); expect(adj.title).toContain("Corporate Development");
    const inh = generate({ companyId: "hindustan-unilever", domain: "LEG", level: "SENIOR" });
    expect(inh.relevance.class).toBe("I"); expect(inh.banner ?? "").toContain("In-house");
    const x = generate({ companyId: "1lattice", domain: "TEL", level: "CAMPUS" });
    expect(x.relevance.class).toBe("X"); expect(x.banner ?? "").toContain("Atypical");
  });
  it("switching role changes the title and responsibilities", () => {
    const base = generate({ companyId: "goldman-sachs", domain: "IB", level: "CAMPUS" });
    const alt = generate({ companyId: "goldman-sachs", domain: "IB", level: "CAMPUS", roleId: base.roleOptions[1].id });
    expect(alt.title).not.toBe(base.title);
    expect(alt.responsibilities.join("|")).not.toBe(base.responsibilities.join("|"));
  });
  it("'Other' works for every company type and never names a real company", () => {
    for (const a of ARCHETYPES) {

      expect(c.disclaimer).toMatch(/not an official JD of any company/);
      expect(c.companyName).toBe(`Other – ${a.name}`);
    }
  });
});

describe("rules and conversion", () => {
  it("no experience-gated credential is required at Campus; no pay figures appear", () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) for (const d of DOMAINS) {
      const c = generate({ companyId: pick(i).id, domain: d, level: "CAMPUS" });
      expect(c.certifications.required).not.toMatch(EXP_GATED);
      expect(JSON.stringify(c)).not.toMatch(/\d\s?LPA|₹\s?\d[\d.,]*\s?(L\b|lakh)/i);
    }
  });
  it("degree knockout applies only to CORE Campus JDs", () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) for (const d of DOMAINS) for (const l of LEVELS) {
      const c = generate({ companyId: pick(i).id, domain: d, level: l });
      if (c.relevance.class !== "C" || l !== "CAMPUS") expect(c.scoring.requiredDegrees.length).toBe(0);
    }
  });
  it("validates picker input and rejects unknown companies, missing type for Other, and bad levels", () => {
    expect(SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({ companyId: "Hindustan-Unilever", domain: "mkt", level: "campus" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({ companyId: "no-such-co", domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({ companyId: "other", domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({ companyId: "other", archetype: "ar11", domain: "SAL", level: "MID" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SampleChoiceV3.safeParse({ companyId: "itc", domain: "MKT", level: "JUNIOR" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it("picker data lists companies, company types, 28 domains and 4 levels", () => {
    const p = getPickerDataV3();
    expect(p.companies.length).toBe(835); expect(p.otherTypes.length).toBe(45); expect(p.domains.length).toBe(28); expect(p.levels.length).toBe(4);
  });
  it("cards convert to valid JDFacts and text; company names are not treated as skills", () => {
    const choice = SampleChoiceV3.parse({ companyId: "swiggy", domain: "PM", level: "EARLY" });
    const card = getCardV3(choice);
    const f = toJDFactsV3(card);
    expect(f.hardSkills.filter(h => h.mustHave).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5);
    expect(f.hardSkills.some(h => h.name === "Swiggy")).toBe(false);
    expect(toJDTextV3(card).length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(sampleNotesV3(card).disclaimer).toMatch(/Illustrative sample/);
  });
  it("a company JD scores deterministically through the existing scorer", () => {
    const jd = toJDFactsV3(getCardV3(SampleChoiceV3.parse({ companyId: "hindustan-unilever", domain: "MKT", level: "CAMPUS" })));
    const resume = {
      headline: "MBA candidate (Marketing)",
      roles: [{ title: "Summer Intern – Brand Management", org: "Example FMCG", type: "internship" as const, startYYYYMM: "2026-04", endYYYYMM: "2026-06",
        bullets: [{ id: "r0b0", text: "Built a launch plan using consumer insights and market share data, lifting trial by 9% in two pilot cities" }] }],
      education: [{ degree: "PGDM", specialisation: "Marketing", institute: "Example B-School", year: "2027" }],
      certifications: [], skillsListed: ["marketing strategy", "consumer insights", "digital marketing", "Nielsen", "brand management"],
      sectionsFound: ["Education", "Experience", "Skills", "Projects", "Achievements", "Positions of Responsibility"],
    };
    const parsed = { text: "word ".repeat(450), pages: 1, layout: { multiColumn: false, scanned: false, tablesLikely: false, contactOnlyInHeaderFooter: false } };
    const emb = { jdSkills: jd.hardSkills.map(() => [1, 0, 0]), resumeSkills: resume.skillsListed.map(() => [0, 1, 0]), jdTitle: [1, 0, 0], resumeTitles: [[0, 1, 0]] };
    const a = score(resume, jd, parsed, emb, resume.skillsListed);
    const b = score(resume, jd, parsed, emb, resume.skillsListed);
    expect(a.overall).toBe(b.overall);
    expect(a.overall).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(a.overall).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
  });
});
```

## 5. Maintaining the database

- **Curate a company** (the best way to make JDs more distinctive): in `companies.json`, set `businessLines` (3 short public business lines), optionally `programme`, `companyEligibility` (with an evidence label), `ladder` (function-agnostic titles only) or `campusTitle`, and set `curated: true`. Re-run the tests. Curated companies keep their best-fit role (no peer rotation).
- **Change a company's class for a domain**: edit the 28-character `relevance` string (order in `meta.domains`) and the matching code in `relevanceEvidence` (`CU` for curated).
- **Add a company**: add a record with the same fields; pick the closest company type (`arche`). Unknown IDs are rejected by the picker validation.
- **Add a role**: add it to `roles.json` with a unique `domain:slug` ID, `byLevel` responsibilities, skills, tools, keywords and `affinity` (company-type codes, best fit first).
- **Re-verify every placement season**: PMI (after 1 December 2026), GARP, SEBI/NISM, IRDAI, PSU notices (Coal India, RBI Grade B) and company programme pages.
- Bump `GENERATOR_VERSION` in `jdgen.ts` whenever generation logic changes, and `LIBRARY_VERSION_V3` when data changes, so stored results remain traceable.

## 7. Quality results

| Check | Rule | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 Company relevance | Company cards name the company in the summary and in at least 2 responsibilities (1 for ATYPICAL). | 117,563/117,563 |
| Q2 Domain relevance | At least 80% of ATS keywords come from the domain and role lexicons (company tokens ≤ 4). | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q3 Level relevance | Experience band matches the level; the scope line matches the level; no experience-gated credential is required at Campus. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q4b Identical text | No two featured-role cards have identical full text (title, summary, all responsibilities, eligibility, required certifications). | 98,560/98,560 |
| Q4a Uniqueness | Every featured-role card has a unique content fingerprint (title, summary, first responsibilities, eligibility, certifications). | 98,560/98,560 |
| Q5 Class banners | Every INTERNAL, ADJACENT and ATYPICAL card carries a banner; CORE cards do not. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q6 Eligibility labelled | Every eligibility note carries a source and an evidence label. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q8 No compensation | No salary, CTC, LPA or stipend figure appears in any card. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q9 No guarantees | No card promises placement, selection or jobs. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q10 Disclaimer | Every card carries the 'Illustrative sample … not an official JD' disclaimer. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q11 Misattribution guard | Rules from other countries (UFLP Bangladesh, Airtel Nigeria, Nestlé Malaysia) never appear as eligibility. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q12 Brand | The old name 'Career Clinic' never appears. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q13 Structure | 8–10 responsibilities, 15–25 ATS keywords, at most 5 must-haves, at least 1 role option, non-empty title. | 123,884/123,884 |
| Q14 Library consistency | A domain the library lists as hired by the company is classed CORE unless a curated override applies. | 93,520/93,520 |
| Q15 Level-hired flag | If the library does not record MBA hiring at a level, the card says the level is extrapolated. | 93,520/93,520 |

Similarity between peers (token Jaccard, same domain and level): same company type, full JD mean 0.77 (95th percentile 0.93); company lines only 0.56; different company types 0.61. **FLAG:** the target of full-JD similarity below 0.60 between peers is met by 5.7% of same-type pairs. Most overlap is the shared role description; curating business lines for more of the 640 uncurated companies is the main fix (Section 5).

## 8. Assumptions and flags

- **ASSUMPTION** — Company types were assigned from the library's sector text with manual overrides; domain classes beyond library-recorded hiring are company-type defaults (INFERENCE).
- **ASSUMPTION** — Business lines for 195 companies come from public descriptions; the others are personalised from the library sector only (flagged on their JDs).
- **ASSUMPTION** — Most companies publish no percentage cut-off; company-type norms are used and labelled.
- **FLAG** — 518 companies have Low confidence in the library (not matched to a placement report); their JDs say so.
- **FLAG** — Levels the library does not record for a company are generated and marked "extrapolated".
- **CONFLICT** — Coal India Finance MT qualification differs between copies of the notice; IRDAI IC-38 training hours (15/25/50/75); Deloitte UG floor (60% vs 65%); AIBE enrolment sequence.
- **FLAG** — Misattributed rules are blocked: UFLP work-experience limit (Unilever Bangladesh), Airtel 0–3 years (Nigeria), Nestlé CGPA 3.2 (Malaysia).
- **FLAG** — Corporate changes to re-check: Tata Motors demerger, JioStar merger, BYJU'S insolvency; DAMAC roles are in Dubai.
- **FLAG** — Not verified: Amazon, Flipkart and ICICI Bank campus-programme names (not used); 2026 placement reports for IIM C/L/K/I, ISB, SPJIMR, MDI, IIFT, NMIMS, JBIMS.
- **FLAG** — The picker component (.tsx) was not type-checked in the sandbox (no React typings there); all `.ts` files were type-checked with `tsc --strict`.

---

## 9. Security, privacy and legal

- The v3 routes serve generated reference data only (no personal data) and can be public and cached. `/api/check` remains login-gated.
- Validate every input with `SampleChoiceV3` (done in the routes and intake); unknown companies, roles, domains or levels return 400.
- Real company names appear only in clearly labelled illustrative samples. Do not use company logos. Remove a company on request by deleting its record and re-running the tests.
- No compensation, no guarantee language, and no protected characteristics are used anywhere in the data or generator.

## 10. Acceptance checklist

1. `npm run jd:extract:v3` writes six files and every checksum passes (companies 835, archetypes 45, roles 236, base 112, hooks 28, meta 3).
2. `npm run test`: 14 v3 tests and 11 v2 tests pass.
3. `npm run build` succeeds.
4. Typing "unil" in the company box shows Hindustan Unilever; choosing Marketing + Campus previews "Management Trainee (UFLP) – Brand Management".
5. Choosing Coal India + Human Resources + Campus shows the 60% / age-30 rule with its VERIFIED label.
6. Choosing Tata Administrative Services + Investment Banking + Early shows the ADJACENT banner and "Corporate Development & M&A".
7. Choosing Other → Indian private bank → SME banking + Sales + Mid previews a JD that names no real company.
8. Clicking another role chip changes the title and responsibilities; submitting sends `jdRole`.
9. Submitting a sample JD stores `libraryVersion = jdlib-2026.10-v3` and a `sampleJdId` of the form `company|DOMAIN|LEVEL|role`.
10. The v2 `jdId` route (`/api/jds/CON-CAMPUS`) and old results still work.
11. Every preview shows the disclaimer, eligibility label, flags and (where present) the class banner.
